entities.name: Hugh I of Arborea
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugh I judike of Arborea from 1185 until his death in 1211. Hugh was the son of Ispella di Serra and Hugh I of Bas. He was a grandson -through his mother- of Barisone II of Arborea.
